existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `ObservationDefinition` has material local breaking changes between R4 and R6. The top migration concerns are the new required modifier `status`, removal/replacement of quantitative details, restructuring of qualified intervals and coded value sets, and R6-only metadata/composition features that cannot round-trip to R4. Confidence is high for structural validation effects and medium for terminology/rationale details.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should be treated as a resource remodel rather than a simple version bump. R4 instances must gain a valid publication `status`; R4 quantitative details need a policy-driven transform to `permittedUnit` plus `permittedDataType=Quantity`; R4 qualified intervals need path renames and semantic review; and R4 top-level ValueSet references need conversion from `Reference(ValueSet)` to canonical URLs under `qualifiedValue`. R6-to-R4 conversion will often require extensions or lossy omission for canonical metadata, derivation, subject/performer/specimen/device/group/component fields, and context-specific qualified value sets.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high because the R4 and R6 StructureDefinitions and package index entries were present and directly compared. Confidence is lower for intended rationale, real-world prevalence, and external terminology consequences because official diffs, narrative pages, and terminology expansions were not supplied.
